sections.title: 9-Layer Anti-Content ID Protection System
sections.content:
ClipShield applies 9 sequential layers of transformation to ensure your repurposed videos bypass YouTube Content ID:
1. Audio pitch and subtle frequency shift
2. Cinematic multi-band color grading

4. Video metadata and container spoofing

7. Micro-visual grain overlay
8. Audio waveform phase alteration
9. Non-repeating keyframe interval insertion.
